chunks: Hanan, from his father, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

I said to him, 'Were the children of Yaqoub prophets?' He said, 'No, but they were the tribes (descendants) of the children of the prophets, and they did not depart from the world except as happy, having repented and remembered what they had done. And indeed, the two old men (Shaykhayn) departed from the world, and they did not repent nor remember what they had done with the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him). So upon them is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all of mankind.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)
key_terms.الشَّيْخَيْنِ: The two old men (referring to Abu Bakr and Umar)

ai.seo_question: What is the Shia view on the repentance and status of the two Caliphs (Shaykhayn) regarding Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) distinguishes the children of Jacob as righteous descendants rather than prophets, noting their ultimate happiness through repentance. He contrasts this with the 'two old men' (Abu Bakr and Umar), asserting they died without repenting for their treatment of Ali ibn Abi Talib, thereby incurring the divine curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. This hadith underscores the Shia view of their posthumous status and the significance of their actions regarding the Imamate.

en.hubeali: H 14791 – Hanaan, from his father, who has said: Abu Ja’farasws said, when I said to himasws, ‘What were the children of Yaqoubas, Prophetsas?’

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, but they were the grandchildren of the children of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>, and they did not depart from the world except as happy, repentant, and remembered what they had done, and the two old men (Abu Bakr and Umar – Shaykhayn) departed from the world, and they never remembered what they had done with Amir-ul-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, so upon these two be the Curses of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the Angels, and the people altogether’.
en.sarwar: 344. Hanaan, from his father, who has said: Abu Ja’far (a.s.) said, when I said to him (a.s.), ‘What were the children of Yaqoub (as), Prophets (as)?’

He (a.s.) said: ‘No, but they were the grandchildren of the children of the Prophets (as), and they did not depart from the world except as happy, repentant, and remembered what they had done, and the two old men (Abu Bakr and Umar – Shaykhayn) departed from the world, and they never remembered what they had done with Amir-ul-Momineen (a.s.), so upon these two be the Curses of Allah (azwj), and the Angels, and the people altogether’.
